scope: Pre-implementation contract and inactive 28-claim lifecycle model; not production implementation acceptance.

input_verification.root_recomputed_from: SHA256 of canonical compact sorted-key files array

resolved_review_concerns.issue: Existing ProtocolState admits Parse separately from repeatable Bind/Execute; Parse-only sequence checks would be insufficient.
resolved_review_concerns.resolution: Frozen sql_protocol.execution_fence explicitly advances on actual completion and Ready, restricts unnamed one Bind/Execute(maxRows=0)/Sync, denies repeated or reordered frames and pipeline, and requires successful COMMIT Ready(I) plus Terminate. Negative protocol matrix cases are mandatory.

assessment: Sticky per-generation failure prevents cleanup completion from becoming context success; CLI also requires staged data, exact owner/nonce/generations and successPermitted.
Exact Store snapshot, scope and full-history semantics remain required. ParserGate/source preservation remain mandatory; new timeout SQL is restricted to owned preludes and canonical SQL route.
Durable journal-before-connect, exact metadata absence after binding, and secret-bound cancellation avoid PID-only signal authority and early capacity release.
Observer lifecycle, Linux peer/process evidence, fsync, clocks and adapter correspondence are explicitly runtime TCB obligations rather than proved model facts.
Pre-key context and observer uncertainty intentionally retain reservations and block replacement; no universal prompt recovery is claimed.
15 ordinary live handlers are not an actual PostgreSQL backend bound; backend-tail slot exhaustion is a fail-closed unavailable outcome.
limitations: No production code was changed or runtime acceptance executed by this review.
Two isolated matching clean model builds and all six exact-root approvals remain activation prerequisites.
Runtime plan is a design: executable drivers, fault barriers, fixtures and verifiers must be frozen and all required cases assessed before runtime acceptance.
Full permitted history/quota fixtures, existing SQL/durable/backup regressions and actual 4-vCPU/8-GiB target performance remain independent promotion/commercial gates.
This approval does not close P1 prompt automatic pre-key restart availability or certify commercialization.
